about_the_game:
Step into this quiet natute sanctuary where moths hide in plain side.

In Mothkeep you explore peaceful habitats where you carefully spot and document moths in every stage of life: from tiny egg to sparkly adult. 
There is no rushing and no catching. Only observation, curiosity, and the joy of slowly filling your journal page by page.
Expect 2 to 4 hours of cozy moth-spotting in nature.

Observe moths & complete your journal 🦋

Discover a range of different moth species and each of its four growth stages. Try to get a good look at each of them with careful timing and patience.

Each habitat has its own native moths waiting to be discovered. Hover over the environment to spot subtle hints and reveal hidden moths.

Page by page, your journal fills with notes and sketches.

Attract moths 💡

Some moths are shy or simply hard to spot.

With colorful flowers, sweets and other treats, you can find them more easily. The shop offers you all you’ll need. Including hints to where certain moths prefer to appear, helping you track down missing entries in your journal.

Placing these items in the environment will actively attract moths, helping your search and making the surroundings brigther and more lively.

What is Mothkeep?✨

  • Short creature-collecting game:

    2-4 hours of focused, cozy gameplay. The perfect snack for a stay-in evening.

  • Simple game mechanics:

    Hidden object exploration with a relaxed moth-spotting mini-game. 

  • Calm summer vibes:

    Enjoy the summer in nature! Happy little accidents open the door to new adventures.

  • Real world inspiration:

    Learn about a curated selection of day-active moths in Central Europe.

What is Mothkeep NOT?🙅

  • No open-world exploration.

  • No long quest chains or epic storylines.

  • No multiplayer, no PVP, no trading.

  • No spiders.

Developer Note 🐛

Hey, I'm ivi and this is my very first solo Steam release. Everything in this game is made by a human (to be precise: by me and some of my lovely friends - look into the credits and have a look at their work, too!!). 
I really hope you enjoy this little game 🦋💕

Ready to begin your summer in Mothkeep? 🌞

Take your journal and see what’s hiding among the flowers.

Whether you’re here to complete your journal or simply enjoy a quiet moment in nature, Mothkeep is waiting.

Wishlist Mothkeep now and start your moth-spotting journey! 🦋

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: x86 / x64
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: If you have a potato PC and the game runs slowly on it, feel free to contact me so I can update this.

short_description: Sometimes curiosity is all it takes to see the hidden whimsy. Step into a peaceful nature sanctuary and discover its native moths, one journal entry at a time. ✒️🦋🐛✨
